description: Under the authority of FAR 6.302-1, Only One Responsible Source, the Army Contracting Command-Detroit Arsenal (ACC-DTA) intends to award a Two-Year Requirement, Sole Source Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) Hardware to O.F. Mossberg & Sons Inc. for the M500 Shotgun Breaching Barrel Kit estimated 246 each of National Stock Number (NSN)1005-01-684-6687, Part number 13075614. The total estiamted value of this contract is $80,704.
